claims.text: EKG monitoring for all cluster pts on verapamil (AV block, symptomatic bradycardia).
claims.quote: We therefore strongly recommend EKG monitoring in all patients with cluster headache on verapamil, to observe for the potential development of atrioventricular block and symptomatic bradycardia.
claims.locator: Cohen AS, Matharu MS, Goadsby PJ. Electrocardiographic abnormalities in patients with cluster headache on verapamil therapy. Neurology 2007;69(7):668-675

claims.text: Expert consensus only on a pretreatment EKG to screen for arrhythmia.
claims.quote: The panel agreed only on performing pretreatment EKG to screen for pre-existing cardiac arrhythmia.
claims.locator: Cardiac monitoring of high-dose verapamil in cluster headache: An international Delphi study. Cephalalgia 2016;36(14):1385-1388
